src_out.description: Defaults to the end of the music or of the video

id.description: Id for the new clip; generated if omitted

index.description: Position in the video track; None = append

font.description: anton/bebas: condensed caps; poppins: round sans; dmserif/instrument: serif; marker: hand-drawn; mono: typewriter

size.description: Font size as a fraction of the frame height; null = the look's

outline.description: Outline width as a fraction of the font size; null = the look's

AudioClean.description: Cleaning up a clip's sound: noise reduction, and a voice treatment (rumble cut, presence, leveling).

voice.description: Make speech clearer: cut rumble, lift presence, even out the level

AudioClean.title: AudioClean

AudioItem.description: Music on the audio track, at an absolute timeline time.

duck.description: Lower the music while someone speaks

audio_clean.description: Noise reduction and voice treatment, as on clips

AudioItem.title: AudioItem

Backdrop.description: What fills the frame around a clip shown whole (fit): the clip itself, filled and blurred, or a color.

blur.description: Gaussian blur sigma as a fraction of the frame height

Backdrop.title: Backdrop

BgRemove.description: Keep what SAM 3.1 finds for `prompt` and replace everything else with a backdrop.

keep.description: main: the biggest match (the subject); all: every match

BgRemove.title: BgRemove

track_id.description: Object track produced by the `track` tool

object_ids.description: Objects of the track to blur; None = all

exclude_ids.description: Objects never blurred (e.g. the main subject)

hold.description: Seconds the blur holds across missed detections

images.description: Reference image ids attached to the message

CheckMark.description: A timeline range the checker flagged, in timeline seconds.
CheckMark.title: CheckMark

CheckResult.description:
The latest checker verdict, kept so its marks survive a reload. `head` is the id of the newest commit
when it ran: once the timeline moves past it, the marks may no longer line up.
CheckResult.title: CheckResult

ChromaKey.description: Make a color (a green or blue screen) transparent.

similarity.description: How far from the color still counts as screen

ChromaKey.title: ChromaKey

speed.description: 0.5 = slow motion, 2 = twice as fast; audio is muted when not 1

crop.description: Empty = centered crop; times are clip-local timeline seconds

crop_rect.description: Edges of the source cut off before it fills the frame

fit.description: fill crops to the frame; fit shows the whole picture over a backdrop (e.g. landscape in 9:16)

backdrop.description: Behind a clip shown with fit

transform.description: Position, scale, rotation and flip in the frame; None = fill the frame

transform_keys.description: Animated position/scale/rotation/opacity; overrides those of `transform` (flips stay)

transition.description: Transition into this clip from the previous one

bg_remove.description: Background replaced using a SAM 3.1 mask (made by remove_background)

audio_fade_in.description: Seconds the clip's sound fades in

audio_fade_out.description: Seconds the clip's sound fades out

ClipAnim.description: An entrance or exit: zoom_in grows from small, zoom_out shrinks from big; slide_* moves that way.
ClipAnim.title: ClipAnim

ClipLut.description: A LUT uploaded to the project (.cube), applied before the grade.
ClipLut.title: ClipLut

CropKey.description: Crop window center at a clip-local time, normalized to the source frame (0..1).
CropKey.title: CropKey

CropRect.description: Edges cut off the source before it fills the frame, as fractions of its width and height.
CropRect.title: CropRect

DetachAudio.description:
Move a clip's sound to the music track (as its own item, still in sync) and mute the clip, so the
sound can be trimmed, moved or faded on its own.

id.description: Id for the new audio item; generated if omitted

DetachAudio.title: DetachAudio

letterbox.description: Cinema bars to this aspect ratio, e.g. 2.39

Follow.description: The tracked object a clip's crop keys follow; the checker verifies it stays in frame.
Follow.title: Follow

Grade.description:
Color adjustments, all 0 = untouched. Ranges are the safe bounds the renderer accepts.

What each field does to pixels is defined once in auteur/grade.py (and ported to the editor).

highlights.description: Brighten (+) or recover (-) the bright end

shadows.description: Lift (+) or deepen (-) the dark end

log.description: Camera log profile to convert to normal contrast before grading

look.description: Preset this grade came from, for display

Grade.title: Grade

object_ids.description: Objects to keep bright; None = all

recorded_at.description: Capture time from the file's metadata (ISO 8601), if any

scene_id.description: Storyboard scene this video was rendered from (made in code, silent)

image.description: Made from an uploaded picture: a still held as a silent 60s video, or a GIF looped to at least 5s

Overlay.description: A B-roll clip on the second video track, at an absolute timeline time.

layout.description: full covers the frame; the corners are picture-in-picture

box.description: Free position and size; overrides `layout` when set

chroma.description: Key out a green/blue screen (with the normal blend)

blend.description: How the B-roll mixes with the picture under it

Overlay.title: Overlay

OverlayBox.description: A B-roll picture placed freely: its center, and its size as a fraction of the frame (same shape).

x.description: Center, as a fraction of the output width

y.description: Center, as a fraction of the output height

scale.description: Width and height as a fraction of the frame's

OverlayBox.title: OverlayBox

clips.description: Copied clips; they get new ids

last_render.description: Path of the latest render, relative to the project dir

spent.description: Meta Model API spend in USD across all runs

ReferenceImage.description: A still the user wants the grade to look like; the file is <project_dir>/refs/<id>.jpg.
ReferenceImage.title: ReferenceImage

bg_remove.description: null shows the original background again

follow.description: Object the keys follow (set by reframe)

crop_rect.description: null shows the whole source again

letterbox.description: Cinema bars to this ratio (2.39 = scope); null removes

backdrop.description: Blur or color behind a fitted clip; omit to keep the current one

lut.description: A LUT uploaded to the project, with intensity; null removes it

speed.description: 0.5 = slow motion; the clip's source range stays the same

transform.description: null resets the clip to fill the frame

keys.description: Empty removes the animation (the static transform applies again)

transition.description: Into this clip from the previous one; null removes it

SpeedRamp.description:
Ease from one speed to another starting at a timeline time: the clip is cut into short steps
with gradually changing speed, and the rest of the clip continues at `to_speed`.

at.description: Timeline time where the ramp starts

SpeedRamp.title: SpeedRamp

new_clip_id.description: Id for the right half; generated if omitted

StoryScene.description:
One scene of a video made in code: Muse Wonder writes it as a Remotion component, and its render
becomes an ordinary (silent) media file on the timeline.

brief.description: What is on screen: the exact on-screen text, layout, motion

images.description: Reference image ids the scene shows

status.description: draft: brief changed since the last build

StoryScene.title: StoryScene

brief.description: What the whole video is for, in the user's words

style.description: Palette, fonts and motion language every scene shares

TextAnim.description: How a text enters or leaves: fade, pop (grows in), slide_up (rises in), words (one word at a time).
TextAnim.title: TextAnim

text.description: Line breaks (\n) are kept as-is by both the preview and the renderer

look.description: clean: plain white; bold: big bold caps; karaoke: spoken word lights up; box: spoken word in a color box; pop: words appear as they are spoken

font.description: anton/bebas: condensed caps; poppins: round sans; dmserif/instrument: serif; marker: hand-drawn; mono: typewriter

size.description: Font size as a fraction of the frame height; null = the look's

outline.description: Outline width as a fraction of the font size; null = the look's

TextWord.description: One spoken word of a subtitle, in timeline seconds, for word-by-word looks.
TextWord.title: TextWord

linkage.description: Text and B-roll move with the main-track clip they start on (music stays put)

TrackInfo.description: Index entry for an object track; the boxes live in <project_dir>/tracks/<id>.json.
TrackInfo.title: TrackInfo

Transform.description:
Where the (cropped) frame sits in the output: scaled and rotated about its center, flipped, then
moved. Uncovered parts of the output are black. Applied after crop and zoom.

x.description: Horizontal offset as a fraction of the output width (+ = right)

y.description: Vertical offset as a fraction of the output height (+ = down)

Transform.title: Transform

TransformKey.description: The clip's pose at a clip-local time (timeline seconds); straight lines between keys.
TransformKey.title: TransformKey

Transition.description:
How a clip enters from the previous one. Dips fade out to a color and back in without
overlapping; every other kind overlaps the two clips by `duration` (ffmpeg xfade).

kind.description: crossfade blends; slide_* pushes the old clip out; wipe_* reveals the new one with a moving edge; circle opens from the center; zoom zooms into the old clip and fades to the new; dip_* dip through a color

Transition.title: Transition

layout.description: A preset place; clears any free `box`

box.description: Free position and size (drag on the canvas)

size.description: null (sent explicitly) = back to the look's size

outline.description: null (sent explicitly) = back to the look's outline

shadow.description: null (sent explicitly) = back to the look's shadow

VolumeKey.description: Clip volume multiplier at a clip-local time (seconds on the timeline).
VolumeKey.title: VolumeKey

Zoom.description: Slow push in/out over the clip (Ken Burns): scale 1 = the normal crop.
Zoom.title: Zoom

description: Root that pulls every shared type into one schema.
title: Schema
